narrative: Aga Marecka contributed to TrueSight DAO across multiple projects including 20250617_beerhall, 20250617_townhall, Agroverse, Cypher Defense, Recurring Tokenizations, Trinity, and telegram_chatlog, with primary focus on human effort hours, liquidity provision, and strategic game-building activities. She earned rewards for 18 hours of effort via the 100TDG per hour rubric, injected liquidity seven times, and brought on active contributors five times through the Bring Builders initiative. In Build Game - Strategy, Aga participated in Facetime meetings, online polls, strategy reviews, and had two full-scale strategies adopted by the DAO. Her involvement spans from October 2020 to October 2025.
